text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding sample app for Go generator streaming sometimes hangs in integration tests. Repro: small http server -> handler calls generator.Stream(ctx, ...), then returns immediately. Test never finishes.

maria: Minimal snippet:```go\nfunc handler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n ctx := r.Context()\n gen := client.Generator("gpt-xyz")\n stream, _ := gen.Stream(ctx, prompt)\n defer stream.Close()\n // write headers, then stream chunks in a goroutine and return\n go func(){ for chunk := range stream.Chunks() { w.Write(chunk) } }()\n return\n}\n```

maria: Locally I see goroutines stuck in `generator.handshake` and `auth.tokenRefresh` stacks. Adding `time.Sleep` makes it "work" sometimes. :confused:

devx-bot: Thanks for the report, @maria — I've filed DEVEX-1429 and attached the trace. Please add a short reproducer if possible.

sam: I hit this earlier — root cause looks like we spawn the stream handshake in a goroutine that doesn't observe ctx cancellation, and the auth refresh path blocks on an internal mutex while holding network I/O. If handler returns, request ctx cancels but handshake goroutine keeps a reference so the process hangs waiting for Close.

sam: Quick suggestion: ensure the stream handshake accepts a parent ctx and we select on ctx.Done() during any blocking ops: e.g.```go\nfunc (g *generator) startHandshake(ctx context.Context) error {\n req := prepareReq()\n respCh := make(chan *http.Response, 1)\n go func(){ r, _ := httpClient.Do(req); respCh <- r }()\n select {\n case <-ctx.Done(): return ctx.Err()\n case r := <-respCh: return handle(r)\n }\n}\n```

alex: Ergonomics note: the current NewGenerator API returns a `Stream` with Close() only. Could we add `WithContext(ctx)` or `StreamWithCancel(ctx)` to avoid callers having to thread ctx everywhere? That would make http handlers and lambda handlers more straightforward.

kevin: How does Python/JS behave here? Are they doing a ctx-like cancel? We should aim for parity so docs/examples don't diverge.

linda: For the auth part: token refresh currently retries with backoff and holds a mutex to dedupe. If the refresh blocks on network, callers waiting in handshake can block too. We should propagate ctx to the refresh call and also avoid holding the mutex across network calls (do double-check locking).

sam: Agreed. Minimal change: 1) pass ctx into tokenRefresh; 2) make handshake respect ctx.Done(); 3) update sample app to show streaming from handler with an explicit `ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(r.Context())` and `defer cancel()` in the handler so we don't rely on GC.

maria: I can pick up a small PR with tests. Plan: add unit test that starts generator stream in a goroutine, cancels ctx, asserts goroutine exits within 200ms. Will also add integration test that simulates auth slow response.

alex: For DX, also update quickstart sample to show `StreamWithContext` if we add it, and document pattern for HTTP servers. Small snippet for docs:```go\nstream, _ := gen.StreamWithContext(r.Context(), prompt)\ndefer stream.Close()\nfor chunk := range stream.Chunks() { w.Write(chunk) }\n```

kevin: If we change API, mark as minor semver bump and add compatibility shim. We can't break existing callers.

linda: I'll draft the token refresh patch — will avoid blocking the dedupe mutex across network and accept ctx so it returns early on cancel.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll file the demo PR and link to DEVEX-1429. If anyone has a small reproducer snippet I can include (just a tiny net/http server) please paste it here. :rocket:

sam: Pasting an ultra-min repro below (runs and exhibits hang ~50%):```go\npackage main\nimport ("net/http" "context" "time")\nfunc main(){ http.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request){ ctx := r.Context() ; gen := fakeGen() ; s, _ := gen.Stream(ctx, "hi") ; go func(){ for b := range s.Chunks(){ w.Write(b) } }() ; return }) ; http.ListenAndServe(":8080", nil) }\n```

sam: Replace `fakeGen()` with minimal stub that simulates handshake blocking on a `time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)` while not observing ctx.

maria: Perfect — I'll include that. Posting PR link when ready.

devx-bot: DEVEX-1429 updated: PR candidate referenced, reviewers: sam, linda, alex.

maria: Closing loop — tests added, small API shim `StreamWithContext` implemented, token refresh now accepts ctx. All reviewers approved. Thanks team. :tada:
